personality_one_liner: An ultra-premium, cinematic digital vault for high-end collectibles, fusing minimalist museum curation with sleek, Rolex/Apple-inspired interactions and deep matte contrasts.

spacing.rule: Generous and cinematic. Use large margins (lg/xl) between distinct sections to emulate empty gallery walls. Padding inside cards should be spacious.

do's: Bottom tab bar over dark backgrounds
Sticky headers when scrolling long lists (World Registry, Settings)
Floating Action Buttons or single primary CTAs (like 'REVEAL RELIC')
Subtle frosted overlays behind featured Relics on the Home screen
dont's: Do not use glass on form fields or standard list rows
Do not overdo blur intensity; keep it dark, smoky, and subtle

screens.name: Splash
screens.layout: Pure #090909 background. Centered wordmark in display font, matte gold accent. Auto-navigates.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.layout: Cinematic text ('Bem-vindo à Nexora' / 'A exclusividade começa aqui') in upper half. Bottom third contains a glowing/matte gold 'Enter' CTA.

screens.name: Auth (Login & Signup)
screens.layout: Minimalist forms. Inputs are thin border-only (no fill). Labels above inputs. Social buttons are pill-shaped with brand icons.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Showcase user's rarest asset and quick actions.
screens.layout: Large cinematic hero card occupying 50% of the screen showcasing the rarest Relic over a dark frosted background. Below: minimalist horizontal lists or tiles for Collection, World Registry, Invites.

screens.name: Discover & Reveal Relic
screens.purpose: The core unboxing experience. A digital vault opening.
screens.layout: Darkens screen entirely. Relic shape is rendered in center. 'REVEAL RELIC' button at bottom. On press -> Reanimated sequence: Shape scales and rotates, lighting gradient shifts, then sequentially fades in Image -> Name -> Number -> Description.

screens.name: Relic Detail
screens.purpose: The certificate of authenticity and history.
screens.layout: Top half is full-width Relic visual with a subtle gradient scrim. Bottom half scrolls over it, containing the official description, history, and a stark, highly structured 'Certificate' card (showing max qty, remaining, dates, first collector).

screens.name: My Collection
screens.purpose: Gallery view of owned and locked assets.
screens.layout: 2-column grid. Owned Relics display in their metallic gold/accent colors. Undiscovered Relics are rendered in flat #262626 (surfaceTertiary) to signify lock.

screens.name: World Registry
screens.purpose: Ledger of all Relics in existence.
screens.layout: Editorial list layout. Each row has the Relic name, its geometric icon on the left, and a monospace/tabular numbers count on the right (e.g., Genesis 0/1).

screens.name: Profile & Invites
screens.layout: Avatar in a geometric frame. Stats shown as large metrics (Influence, Relic Count). Invites section features a large, copyable code inside a surfaceSecondary container with a subtle gold border.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '6 Glass / Luxe DARK' personality religiously. The background is an unyielding #090909. Avoid grey-heavy screens; rely on contrast and empty space.
Implement real local mock auth logic that securely manages state before showing the Home tab.
For the multi-language requirement, setup an i18n context (PT/EN) so strings dynamically swap.

RELIC SVG INSTRUCTIONS (CRITICAL): Build components using `react-native-svg`. ALL 10 Relics must be minimalist geometric vector shapes with metallic/gradient fills (use react-native-svg LinearGradient/RadialGradient referencing the brand hexes).
4. Eclipse: Disc with an offset corona glow.

The Reveal Animation must feel expensive. Use `react-native-reanimated`. Start with a dark screen, scale up the SVG, apply a slow rotation, and sequentially fade in metadata (Image -> Name -> Number -> Description).
Ensure 'My Collection' dims/grays out undiscovered Relics using #262626 fill, while owned Relics display their matte gold/metallic gradients.
World Registry must show the real max supply counts clearly formatted: '0 / 10000'.
